comments.author: Robert Glaser
comments.comment:
The best test for personal agents is still boring: can it recover from a half-broken local setup without turning one missing env var into a 40-minute debugging session?

I’d love to see more builders compare failure modes, permission boundaries, and eval traces instead of only demoing the happy path.

comments.author: Duarte O.Carmo
comments.comment: One hard part is separating “knows Portuguese” from “knows Brazilian Portuguese patterns and maps them over.” I’d want eval slices for spelling reform variants, clitic placement, formal/informal address, and Portugal-specific entities before looking at broad benchmark scores. How are you planning to weight fluency vs local factuality?

comments.author: Daniel Gamrot
comments.comment: The real win here is separating capture from judgment. Most meeting AI workflows fail because they try to produce a perfect summary immediately, but the missing layer is the 1-2 minute human reflection after the call. That little dictated note often contains the highest-signal context the transcript will never infer.
